'''Marac den Norvin''' is a nobleman from [[Illian]].{{ref|{{twotc}},Marac Pandelaros den Norvin|Marac}}

== Appearance ==
He is a stout man. He is wide with a stolid manner.{{ref||Marac}}

He seems more craftsman than lord, despite his rich silks, falls of lace and lavish armor.{{ref||Marac}}

== Activities ==
He takes the place of Lord Brend on the [[Council of Nine]].{{tpod|13}}

He goes with [[Rand al'Thor]] when Rand tries to deal with the [[Illian]] rebels loyal to Lord Brend.{{tpod|13}}
